title: 'BLUME SALAMANCA' telegram 1, Zurich -> Salamanca via London, 8 Jan 1937 (Swiss Federal Police file on Werner Oswald)

documents.shelfmark: Swiss Federal Police files on Werner Oswald (found by R. Bochsler); photograph from Schmeh's Facebook post

transcription.source: telegram1.jpg, 1,134 x 1,012 px, from Schmeh's Facebook post
transcription.notes: 123 groups; checked against the word count (125) written on the form. The second telegram was out of reach until 30 Sept 2026 (document telegram2). Language is the NOTES' inference (telegraphic Spanish), not established. Corrected 30 Sept 2026: groups 38, 48 and 122 are SOLRS, ACCEL, FTULX (L read as I three times), reported by Richard Bean (GitHub issue 14), confirmed on the photograph and by his SHA-256 of the 615 letters.

documents.shelfmark: Swiss Federal Police files on Werner Oswald (found by R. Bochsler); full image of Schmeh's Facebook post, reached through the image-server link given in GitHub issue 14

transcription.source: telegram2.jpg, 2,048 x 1,376 px, full image of Schmeh's Facebook post
transcription.notes: 32 groups; the SHA-256 of the 160 letters equals the one Richard Bean gave (issue 14), which he says matches W. Higinbotham's transcription in the post's comments. Handed in 17:34 the same day as telegram 1 (serial 1486, fee 14 fr). Language is inferred, as for telegram 1.

system.summary: Transposition of telegraphic Spanish (IC 0.0699, no bigram structure); single transpositions excluded, double columnar with long keys open.
system.notes: Letter profile fits a commercial telegram (few q, many p/t/x) rather than prose.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded. 30 Sept 2026: an outside reader (Richard Bean, GitHub issue 14) supplied three transcription corrections; this session checked them against the photograph and applied them. Bean then pointed to the full image of the second telegram, which Daniel relayed.
tools: IDP divide-and-conquer with exhaustive second key (dt/Idp2.cs)

solution.what: Telegram 1 transcribed from the Facebook photograph; 615 letters checked against the form's word count.
IC 0.0699 and bigram-repeat test identify a transposition; letter profile suggests telegraphic Spanish.
Rail fence, skip, route transpositions (exhaustive) and single columnar to width 20 (annealing), all validated on plants.
Lag scan excludes single columnar at any width and reversed-direction double columnar (w1 x w2 below ~560); controls z 11-22, telegram max z 3.3.
Full-key double-transposition annealing, same key to 30 and two keys to 16 x 16.
IDP local search on the second key; fails on plants at 615 letters.
Exhaustive second-key enumeration, w2 <= 10, forward and both mixed conventions; proven on plants to 41 x 8 and 30 x 10.

Richard Bean (GitHub issue 14) reported three I-for-L misreadings: groups 38, 48 and 122 are SOLRS, ACCEL and FTULX (the typewriter's L has a serif only at the foot). Confirmed on telegram1.jpg, all 123 groups re-read at twice the size with no other difference; the corrected 615 letters match the SHA-256 he gives.

Lag scan re-run on the corrected text: maximum z = 3.4 (was 3.3) at the same lags; index of coincidence 0.0695 (was 0.0699). The errors were substitutions, so no letter moved and the earlier exclusions stand.

Second telegram: the full image of Schmeh's post, which the public preview crops, reached without a login through the Facebook image-server link Richard Bean gave in issue 14 (telegram2.jpg, 2048 x 1376).

Second telegram transcribed: 32 groups, 160 letters (ct2.txt); its SHA-256 equals the one Bean gave, so the reading agrees with his letter for letter. IC 0.071 and a Spanish-like letter mix: another transposition.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only attacks on telegram 1 (615 letters) excluded every single-message transposition family testable on planted controls; the remaining double columnar with long keys is out of reach without the second telegram or a crib.
outcome.notes: Open: double columnar with two long keys. The second telegram (160 letters) is in hand since 30 Sept 2026; a joint attack on both is in progress.
